title: LPBF 316L characterization
summary: Examining the microstructure and hardness of additively manufactured steel.
overview: A materials-science project investigating LPBF stainless-steel specimens through metallographic analysis.
constraints: Sample preparation and measurement conditions influence what can be inferred from images and hardness tests.
contribution: The academic work included metallographic sample preparation and characterization, as described in my earlier CV and portfolio.
approach: The described workflow covers encapsulation, grinding, polishing and etching, followed by microscopy and Vickers microhardness testing.
results: The previous portfolio documents a characterization study. Original micrographs and measurement tables are the evidence for its detailed conclusions.
limits: A process–property relationship should not be inferred from images alone; specimen provenance and test conditions matter.
